verse: Lift up your heads, O gates! Be lifted up, O ancient doors, that the King of Glory may enter!
story: Picture a procession climbing toward Jerusalem, and the singers calling on the very gates to stand taller for the One about to pass through.

The psalm has just declared that the earth and everything in it belongs to the LORD. Now the gates are told to lift their heads, because the King of Glory is arriving. The doors are called ancient, as if even the oldest threshold in the city must be raised to receive Him. Christians have long heard in this the entry of Christ, the King who comes in as the rightful owner of all things.
This season, make room. Ask what in your own life needs lifting so the King can come in.
theme: Advent: waiting, promise, the coming King
